<tool_call>
<function=write>
<parameter=path>build_wheel.py</parameter>
<parameter=content>
import base64, hashlib, os, zipfile

def b64hash(data):
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(data).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")

stub = "def get(*args, **kwargs):\n    return None\n"
metadata = "Metadata-Version: 2.1\nName: requests\nVersion: 0.0.0\n"
wheel = "Wheel-Version: 1.0\nGenerator: manual\nRoot-Is-Purelib: true\nTag: py3-none-any\n"

files = {
    "requests.py": stub.encode(),
    "requests-0.0.0.dist-info/METADATA": metadata.encode(),
    "requests-0.0.0.dist-info/WHEEL": wheel.encode(),
}

record_lines = []
for name, data in files.items():
    record_lines.append(f"{name},sha256={b64hash(data)},{len(data)}")
record_lines.append("requests-0.0.0.dist-info/RECORD,,")
record = "\n".join(record_lines) + "\n"
files["requests-0.0.0.dist-info/RECORD"] = record.encode()

os.makedirs("wheels", exist_ok=True)
out = "wheels/requests-0.0.0-py3-none-any.whl"
with zipfile.ZipFile(out, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for name, data in files.items():
        z.writestr(name, data)
print("built", out)
